description: This file defines the 'Series' class in the MigraDoc library, representing a data series in a chart with various properties and methods for manipulation, serialization, and deep copying.

classes.name: Series
classes.description: Represents a data series in a chart with methods to add data, clone, and serialize the series, as well as properties for styling and data configuration.

classes.name: Series.SeriesValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for 'Series', including elements, colors, styles, and labels.

methods.name: Series
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Series with default values.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Series object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copying process for internal object properties.

methods.name: AddBlank
methods.description: Adds a blank data point to the series.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a numeric data point to the series.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds multiple numeric data points to the series.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the Series object into a serialized DDL string.
